params.caption: O'zbekchada "xato qildim" deymiz, shuning uchun ko'pchilik beixtiyor I did a mistake deb yuboradi. Ingliz tilida esa mistake faqat make bilan ishlatiladi: make a mistake, ya'ni xato qilmoq. I made a silly mistake in the last question. Oxirgi savolda kulgili xato qilib qo'ydim. Everyone makes mistakes when they start speaking. Gapirishni endi boshlaganda hamma xato qiladi. Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Xato qilishdan qo'rqmang. Yana bitta foydali ibora bor: by mistake, ya'ni adashib, bilmasdan. I took your pen by mistake, sorry. Eslab qolishning oson yo'li: do odatda ish va vazifalar bilan keladi (do homework, do the dishes), mistake esa make tomonda turadi, xuddi make progress, make a decision kabi.
